benchmark: data/benchmark/items.jsonl (generator seed 0, 1036 items + 2254 counterfactual variants, 3 datasets, 5 body locations)

eval_plan.tier_B_items: 250 (nested subset of tier A: main_ids_B subset of main_ids)

dtype_rationale: On MPS, fp16 AND bf16 degenerate into '!!!!' repetition on ~2k-token numeric prompts (reproduced for Qwen2.5-0.5B and 1.5B; triggered by a preceding short-prompt generation). The failure yields unparseable output on exactly the long-signal conditions and not on the short no-signal ones, which is indistinguishable from the effect this benchmark measures. Every model additionally passes a load-time long-prompt decode check (HFLLM._check_stability) and the runner refuses to record runs from a model that fails it.

with_signal_long.purpose: generation-cap ablation: removes truncation as an explanation for the negative prior gap

feature_prompt.purpose: all five DSP measurements precomputed in the prompt, no raw samples -- pure result-reading

tool_forced.purpose: the family's correct tool is executed for the model -- result-reading with perfect routing

with_signal_{magnitude,indexed,coarse}.purpose: format robustness; variants derived from the serialized text so they carry no extra information

contam_primed.purpose: contamination-probe POSITIVE CONTROL: three verbatim canonical windows and their published values placed in context, simulating a memorising model

backends.dsp_oracle: deterministic DSP on the serialized signal

generation_cap_rationale: Stage 2 used a 48-token cap, which truncated verbose models mid-reasoning on the no_signal BASELINE (e.g. Llama-3.1-8B: '...around 2.5 steps per second. For a 12-second'). A first-number parser then scored 2.5 rather than the intended 30, deflating the baseline and inflating the prior-reliance gap -- a false positive for 'the signal helps'. Stage 3 uses uniform generous caps, parses the conclusion (explicit 'Final answer:' line, else the LAST value), and reports cap-hit rate per condition as a first-class metric.

statistics.differences: paired item-level percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 12345
statistics.paired_tests: exact McNemar (two-sided binomial on discordant pairs)
statistics.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across the five-family battery within each model
statistics.null_claims: TOST equivalence at a +-0.05 accuracy margin -- the central claim is a null, so a non-significant p is not treated as evidence of absence
statistics.scale: Spearman correlation of accuracy and prior-gap against model size

parallelism: runs sharded across up to 6 concurrent model processes sharing one MPS GPU; per-query latencies are therefore measured under GPU contention (upper bounds); token counts are exact
provenance: paper/tables/*.tex and paper/tables/macros.tex are generated by scripts/make_tables.py from results/metrics.json; paper/main.tex \input()s them, so no number in the paper is transcribed by hand
